title: v1.2.0 — Universal Goal Engine & Reflection Journal
changelog: Universal Goal Engine: Set any personal or professional aspiration with arbitrary categories and flexible tracking modes
Multi-Stage Roadmap Phases: Break ambitious goals into structured milestones, targets, and phase checklists
Custom Lists & Resource Vault: Maintain tailored reading lists, action items, research links, and local references
Experience & Reflection Journal: Log milestones, lessons, mood ratings, and personal breakthroughs
Weekend & Holiday Routine Skip: Option to pause full daily routine on holidays or weekends with 1 tap
Activity Comments & Notes: Add notes, reflections, and thoughts to any daily routine activity
Priority Triage: Filter and organize goals across P0 Critical to P3 Low priorities
Seamless Cloud Sync: Instant Firestore synchronization and offline-first persistence
